evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing.
